Generated Narrative: CodeSystem ng-hiv-int-lab-register-cs

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir-ig.digitalhealth.gov.ng/CodeSystem/ng-hiv-int-lab-register-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
gene-xpert GeneXpertTesting performed using a GeneXpert platform.
m-pima m-PIMATesting performed using an m-PIMA platform.
conventional-pcr Conventional PCR laboratoryTesting performed using a conventional PCR laboratory platform. The source SOP also prints 'PCR LaC'.
1 DevolvedSource register DSD status code 1: devolved.
2 Non-devolvedSource register DSD status code 2: non-devolved.
3 Not eligible for devolvementSource register DSD status code 3: not eligible for devolvement.
vl-undetectable-or-le-50 Target not detected or 50 copies/mL or lessSource A34 category: undetectable or no more than 50 copies/mL.
vl-suppressed-detectable Suppressed but detectableSource A35 category: greater than 50 and no more than 1000 copies/mL.
vl-unsuppressed UnsuppressedSource A36 category: greater than 1000 copies/mL.
routine Routine viral-load monitoringRoutine viral-load monitoring.
targeted Targeted viral-load monitoringViral-load testing prompted by a clinical, immunological, pregnancy, post-EAC, recent-infection or early-detection indication.

title: NG HIV Integrated Laboratory Monitoring Register Codes
description:
Local codes required to represent the Integrated Laboratory Monitoring
Register revised November 2025. The source workbook does not provide a complete
EID-entry-point legend or a POC error-code catalogue; those values are therefore
represented using existing terminology or free text in the logical model.
